limits: Cases authored from review are development tests, not unseen hold-outs.
Same ceiling is not exact length matching.
Condition mask is an instruction boundary; answer style can reveal condition.
Reversal uses another comparator; disagreement cannot isolate order bias from evaluator variability.
Shared model family and executor are not independent training/infrastructure.
No repeated model seeds, cross-model replication or real-project outcome validation.
Scientific-operation fields are empty self-reports; file reads/writes are evaluation operations, not scientific experiments.
